title: Problem-hypothesis threads: customer asks and test backlog
content:
Context and goal:
This doc compiles unstructured customer feedback from the past 10 weeks and groups it into 'problem -> hypothesis -> test' threads. Purpose is to create a small, testable backlog of feature/behavior experiments that resolve the highest-risk asks for Dedicated and Hosted customers. Not a final roadmap; intended as tactical experiments to validate impact quickly.

Data sources used (samples):
- Post-call notes from enterprise pilots (May–Aug 2027)
- Zendesk threads: ~120 messages tagged 'latency' and 'batching'
- Field interviews (CS + Solutions): 9 calls, transcripts in Confluence link above
- Support tickets triage (JIRA-4562, JIRA-4591, JIRA-4678)

Synthesis method (quick):
- Read raw threads and annotate 'pain', 'current workaround', 'ask'
- Group by the customer job-to-be-done the ask is trying to solve
- For each cluster create 1 hypothesis and a minimal experiment we can run in 2–4 weeks

Top 6 problem-hypothesis threads (ranked by frequency * quoted-urgency):
1) Problem: Unexpected tail-latency spikes during mixed workloads on Dedicated pools
   Representative quote: "We hit sporadic spikes when reranking and chat run concurrently; it kills our SLOs."
   Hypothesis: Tail spikes are driven by small numbers of long-sequence rerank requests that block batch windows and trigger context evictions.
   Proposed quick test: Add request-shape routing rule that routes calls with length>1024 tokens to a dedicated low-concurrency lane for 2 weeks; measure 95th/99th pct latencies and error rate.
   Success metric: 95th latency for chat endpoints falls by >=20% with <=3% increase in cost.
   Potential owner: eng-serving-runtime (Marco) + SRE (Evan)

2) Problem: Customers needing partial privacy controls inside Hosted (redact/strip PII before logs)
   Representative quote: "We love Hosted but cannot send PII into logs at all — we need a configurable pre-log hook."
   Hypothesis: A customer-configurable 'pre-log transform' (regex and simple rules) will remove 80% of small enterprise objections and double pilot conversion rate for regulated customers.
   Proposed quick test: Ship a beta 'pre-log filter' toggle and allow 3 regex patterns in Console feature flag for 10 customers. Track pilot progression/CS win-rate.
   Success metric: Two pilot customers move from PoC to contract after filter enabled, and no regression in debug telemetry.
   Potential owner: product-console (Diane) + security (Priya)

3) Problem: Confusion about model variants and fallback behavior during capacity shortages
   Representative quote: "Why did my request suddenly use a different model and the cost changed? No notification."
   Hypothesis: Clear per-route fallback UI and 'fallback log' will reduce escalations and support tickets by 40%.
   Proposed quick test: Add per-route fallback audit log to Console (display only) and email digest to owners for 30 days on 5 pilot customers. Measure support ticket count and NPS signal.
   Success metric: Support tickets referencing 'unexpected model' fall by 40% for participating accounts.
   Potential owner: product-hosted-api (Aisha) + devexp (Marco)
notes_extra:
4) Problem: High cost on reranking workloads when using default batching settings
   Hypothesis: Providing a rerank-specific batching preset (smaller batch, different KV eviction) will reduce tokens billed per effective rerank by 18-30% for top 3 customers.
   Quick test: Expose 'rerank' preset in API and run A/B on one high-volume customer.

5) Problem: Customers running on Private deployments unsure about upgrade paths and rollback guarantees
   Hypothesis: A one-page 'upgrade contract' + automated rollback demo will reduce pre-sale gating questions and shorten procurement time by 25%.
   Quick deliverable: Draft one-pager + recorded upgrade/rollback runbook; put behind a gating form.

6) Problem: Observability gaps for token-level cost attribution across composite routes
   Hypothesis: Token attribution per sub-route (parent request -> child tool calls) will reduce billing disputes and speed root-cause by 2x.
   Quick test: Prototype token-attribution in debug traces for 3 customers and solicit feedback.

Signals to watch (leading & lagging):
- Leading: volume of 'will churn' language in field notes; number of pilot stalls mentioning 'privacy' or 'latency'
- Lagging: conversion from PoC->contract; support ticket counts; SLA breach incidents

Quick wins we can do in 1 sprint:
- Console: Add 'fallback log' display for route owners (display only)
- Support: Ship a pre-signed checklist for Dedicated onboarding with 6 common tuning knobs
- Docs: Short explainer 'Rerank cost vs latency' with two recommended presets

Risks and unknowns:
- Some tail-latency patterns may require kernel-level runtime changes that need >3 sprints
- Privacy filters must be vetted by Security for edge cases (PII extraction false negatives)
- Measuring pilot impact will be noisy — need carefully instrumented cohorts

Immediate next steps (owners & due dates):
- Aisha: draft fallback-log console copy + email template (due 2027-08-23)
- Marco: prototype request-shape routing config and wire SLO metrics (due 2027-08-30)
- Diane: scope pre-log filter beta (security review + config UX) (due 2027-08-25)
- Evan: assemble SRE playbook for evacuation of long-sequence lanes (due 2027-08-29)
- Priya: schedule 2-hour privacy review for pre-log filter (due 2027-08-20)

Open questions for leadership / product review meeting:
- Which of the six threads should be escalated to a roadmap item vs. experimental backlog?
- For Dedicated tail-latency, do we prioritize runtime changes or invest first in routing/shape-based mitigations?
- Resource ask: 0.25 FTE engineer for 6 weeks to run experiments — can we prioritize?

Appendix: sample raw customer snippets (anonymized):
- "We saw random 20s spikes during peak. Our customers are timing out. If you can give us a knob to route long jobs away, we can stay on Dedicated." (Large fintech pilot)
- "We need console toggle to stop logging requests that match our PII rules — legal won't sign without it." (Healthcare startup)
- "There was no hint in logs that the model changed — our cost center saw a 3x bill and we had to escalate." (Marketplace platform)

End of doc.

Quick note on provenance: this is intentionally compact and operational — for longer-form synthesis and full transcript excerpts see Confluence page linked in 'linked_artifacts'.
